plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
deployment: Deployed in shadow on openvibe-ovh: /opt/openvibe.billing (release 421beb4, openvibe-contracts 0.33.0, openvibe-shared 1.5.1), unit openvibe-billing, API on 127.0.0.1:4600 (loopback only; /api/v1 is denied on the public host). Public at https://billing.openvibe.network: the staff console (Network SSO + PKCE, BILLING_STAFF_SUBJECTS = the owner only), /api/health, /api/ready (openvibe-shared/ready shape), /release.json and /webhooks/*. No provider secret is configured, so every provider is off and /webhooks/* answers 404 billing.provider_disabled.
notes: Runtime, journal, adapters, import, reconciliation and the staff console (cashout approve/deny, review queue, reconciliation, freeze, audit log) are built, tested and deployed, with /metrics (loopback only), hourly scheduled reconciliation (GET /api/v1/admin/reconciliations; 16 runs by 2026-09-24 05:06 UTC, ledger-vs-receipt checks), EXTERNAL PowerChat receipts (billing.receipt.external under BILLING_AUTHORITY=billing; recorded only while Live is the authority), overflow guards and IMMEDIATE-transaction settlement. Production holds the shadow import of Live (322 transactions, 996 ledger entries), 0 subscriptions and 0 entitlements; the console has never been used (staff_audit 0). BILLING_AUTHORITY is not set in live.env, so Live stays the money authority. The cutover (README runbook, docs/live-cutover.md) waits on the owner putting the PowerChat secret in billing.env and re-pointing the PowerChat webhook to https://billing.openvibe.network/webhooks/powerchat; a duplicate-webhook proof in production follows it. Live's payouts, refunds and plans have no tables of their own; where they map is docs/live-mapping.md.
